title: Read complete criterion intent with safe authored context
preconditions: A criterion has a short title, full statement and Markdown containing emphasis, a script tag and a javascript link.

steps.action: Open the story and dedicated criterion pages.
steps.expected_result: Both retain the full criterion statement alongside its authored short title.

steps.action: Inspect the rendered Markdown and attempt the unsafe link/script payloads.
steps.expected_result: Emphasis renders; script elements and javascript links do not.

expected_result: Read complete criterion intent with safe authored context.
